renderedScreens.instruction: Implement the Superpowers invocation policy in the AGENTS repository workflow. Before each new Superpowers skill or command invocation, reproduce the previously agreed twelve-row activity-to-skill mapping verbatim, identify the applicable skill, load its instructions, and apply them. Read applicable AGENTS.md and README first; respect workspace permissions. Return the implementation status as {$implementationStatus}.

Superpowers invocation mapping (reproduce verbatim before each new skill or command):
1. Read AGENTS.md, README, and existing source | brainstorming | Grounded requirements and constraints
2. Define the command-shell architecture | brainstorming | Architecture specification
3. Define application and issue authorization | brainstorming | Validator interface and access rules
4. Identify scripts, functions, and files to change | writing-plans | Implementation plan and file mapping
5. Isolate changes from active code | using-git-worktrees | Isolated development branch/workspace
6. Develop command-dispatch and validation tests | test-driven-development | Failing tests demonstrating required behavior
7. Implement the shell commands and adapters | executing-plans | Working implementation
8. Investigate failed executions | systematic-debugging | Root-cause analysis and corrections
9. Coordinate independent development tasks | dispatching-parallel-agents | Parallel task results, where supported
10. Review implementation against requirements | requesting-code-review | Findings and required corrections
11. Verify actual behavior | verification-before-completion | Test results, execution logs, and diffs
12. Promote approved changes | finishing-a-development-branch | Reviewed integration commit or pull request
